ValidationRule.description: Validates the quote is locked and cannot be modified by its status is Rejected, Accepted, or Denied.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Rejected", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Accepted", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Denied" ), ISCHANGED(SBQQ__Status__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Quote is locked and cannot be modified because its status is Rejected, Accepted, or Denied.
